name: CoinGecko API
rate_limits: Demo plan: 100 calls a minute and 10,000 call credits a month (source: https://www.coingecko.com/en/api/pricing). A simple price call worked with no key (tested).
history_start: Demo plan: 1 year of daily and hourly history.
what_it_has: Prices, market caps and volumes for thousands of coins, averaged across exchanges.
simple: A website that tracks the price of almost every cryptocurrency and lets programs ask for it.
license_terms: Attribution required on the free plan. Commercial use is allowed with attribution, but reselling or redistributing API access is not. https://www.coingecko.com/en/api/pricing
quality_notes: Aggregated prices, not one exchange's trades. One year of history on the free plan is short.

relevance.reason: Easy crypto prices, but short history and off our main currency focus.
